prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic, moody street scene set in the early morning or late afternoon, with cool, desaturated tones dominating the color palette. The composition centers on a young man in a dark business suit and tie, lying motionless on his back on the asphalt beside a parked car, his head turned to the side and his body partially on a concrete slab. His glasses have fallen off and rest nearby, and a briefcase lies open next to him, its contents just out of view. The street is mostly empty, with a few cars parked along the curb and a faint line of greenery and fencing in the background. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows and lending a somber, contemplative mood to the scene. The camera angle is low and slightly off-center, emphasizing the vulnerability and stillness of the subject, while the shallow depth of field keeps the focus on the foreground, subtly blurring the distant background. The overall style evokes a sense of quiet tragedy and urban isolation, reminiscent of a dramatic film still or a photographic tableau.
